newsitem.title: USA: Hurricane watch in Bahamas, Fran moving toward Fla.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane watch in Bahamas, Fran moving toward Fla.

text.p: A hurricane watch was in effect for the central and northwestern Bahamas, as Hurricane Fran moved west-northwest toward Florida on Tuesday, the National Hurricane Center said.

At 1100 EDT/1500 GMT, Fran's center was near latitude 24.9 north and longitude 71.6 west, or about 365 miles (590 km) east of Nassau in the Bahamas. The storm was moving west-northwest near 12 mph (19 kmh), and a gradual turn toward the north was expected during the next 24 hours, forecasters said.

Maximum sustained winds increased slightly to near 85 mph (140 kmh) and some strengthening was likely during the next 24 hours. Hurricane force winds extended outward up to 85 miles (140 km) from the center and tropical storm force winds extended outward up to 175 miles (280 km).
The hurricane watch was in effect from Acklins Island northwestward in the Bahamas. It indicates maximum sustained winds of 74 mph (119 km) or higher. The hurricane was expected within 36 hours,
A tropical storm warning was in effect from Acklins Island to Cat Island. It indicates maximum sustained winds from 39 to 73 mph (63 to 117 kmh). The storm was expected within 24 hours or less.
